headline: Energy Audit, from entry to detail
overview: Log daily work tasks with energy levels and time spent. See weekly energy metrics to understand which activities energize or drain you.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Energy Audit — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the initial state and main interface with task logging form and energy level selector.
steps.screenshotAlt: Energy Audit landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Log daily work tasks with associated energy levels
Track time spent on each task
View weekly energy metrics and patterns
Identify which activities energize or drain you
tips: Log tasks immediately after completing them for the most accurate energy ratings.
Review your weekly metrics each Friday to spot patterns and optimize your schedule.
